text: The owned shared handler captures old flags, applies the new header and calls NotifyHdrChangeAll with a null instigator. The checked database receiver requires an existing header, and the view updates rows when it is not the instigator. Both success and operation-failure callbacks attempt count and folder-summary refresh before reporting their existing final status and accumulated additions. Those refresh calls can fail early; no unconditional completion or reproduced UI result is established. Accepted Exchange code retains this sequence and adds later subject handling.
title: Exchange message updates notify matching views after applying headers and refresh counts on both terminal paths
